crossCuttingLeads: committee_count/committees-array parity holds cleanly for all 5 group-H MPs (10/10, 4/4, 3/3, 4/4, 2/2) — the just-fixed methodology validates across this batch with zero anomalies, unlike the systematic +1 pattern seen in batch-005.

Systematic scope gap, seen independently in 4 of 5 MPs: committee_count/leadership_count never counts subcommittee (podvýbor) memberships or subcommittee leadership, nor parliamentary-club leadership, nor inter-parliamentary friendship-group chairmanship. Concretely: Chochelová chairs the CZ–Chile friendship group and sits on 9 uncounted subcommittees; Stojanová is Pirate club vice-chair (klub-level, uncounted); Volpe has chaired-adjacent vice-chair of a subcommittee since March 2026; Hřib vice-chairs the Transport subcommittee. leadership_count=0 for 4 of these 5 MPs therefore understates real functional leadership load — worth a methodology note for Case ① rather than a per-MP anomaly.

All 5 MPs share tenureClass=full_term, tenureDays=293, contributionPsp9=null — none are replacements and none have a PSP9 comparison; for Zdeněk Hřib specifically this null is expected (he was Prague mayor 2018-2022, not a PSP9 deputy), but the other four's null should be interpreted as 'first term in the Chamber', not a data gap, unless disproven.

Cross-MP bill-sharing is internally consistent: tisk 120 (income tax) correctly appears in both Chochelová's and Smejkalová's sponsoredBills with each other cross-listed as coSponsor; tisk 168 (VAT) and tisk 215 (soudní řád správní) correctly cross-reference Stojanová, Volpe, and Hřib. No double-counting artifacts observed.

Legislative-fate pattern across the whole group: of the ~14 unique tisky touched by these 5 MPs, none has passed or been rejected as of 2026-07-25; one (tisk 36, Chochelová) was withdrawn by its own submitters. Government issued 'nesouhlas' on the clear majority of the rest. This is consistent with a young opposition/coalition-fragmented term and should temper any 'legislative achievement' framing in bill_focus fields for this cohort — output so far is procedural traction, not enacted law.
None of the 5 group-H MPs have linkedCompanies — no ARES/VR money verification was required or performed for this group.
